summary: Hafnia Limited filed a Form 6-K on September 8, 2026, furnishing a press release dated September 7, 2026, announcing that its shares are trading ex-dividend. The dividend is USD 0.5003 per share for the second quarter of 2026, as previously announced on August 28, 2026. The ex-dividend date is September 7, 2026 on the Oslo Stock Exchange and September 8, 2026 on the New York Stock Exchange. This is a routine dividend distribution announcement with no strategic or structural implications. The filing focuses solely on the mechanics of the dividend payment timing across exchanges. What to watch: no further action required; this is a standard capital return event.
